_meta.title: Session 26 — Scout sweep: mai-image-2.5-preview launch (May 26) + HiDream-O1 AA leaderboard score
_meta.context: Daily scout sweep after Session 25. Two new T2I findings: (1) Microsoft AI mai-image-2.5-preview launched May 26 2026 onto arena.ai Text-to-Image leaderboard at rank #3 (1254 Elo, 5,264 votes) — +72 Elo lift over predecessor mai-image-2 (1182). (2) HiDream-O1-Image-Dev-2604 (already in DB from May 21 arena.ai changelog) now has a concrete AA leaderboard score: 1189 Elo on Artificial Analysis Text-to-Image arena (rank #8 overall, #1 open-weights). Arena T2I top-10 refresh confirms vote-count growth (gpt-image-2 +1.3k votes, gemini-3-pro-image +1.4k, etc.) — vote counts updated to May 26 snapshot. Skip: All arxiv refs (QUIET / AttuneBench / EnergyAgentBench / GroupMemBench / AgentRx / Soohak) have no concrete per-model scores in abstracts — defer to PDF deep-mining in a future session.
